target_text:
// Copy one token between packed K planes, or within one plane. The token indices
// are checked by load_row and store_row.
body:
**[comments] Rule 4, comment lines that map to no code line: shorten**

"Gathered into a 64-byte-aligned local row (load_row) and scattered into its destination column (store_row)" restates the three-line body. "Tokens own disjoint slots, so no other token of the destination is touched" restates the callee contract of store_row (and the header, lines 27-29). What stays: that source and destination may be the same plane, and why this function has no assert of its own.

Proposed:
```cpp
// Copy one token between packed K planes, or within one plane. The token indices
// are checked by load_row and store_row.
```
